command: import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; import {gunzipSync} from "node:zlib"; import {createHash} from "node:crypto"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; const controls=JSON.parse(gunzipSync(readFileSync(".scratch/prototypes/p1-cad/evidence/findings-repair/cache-order-controls.json.gz"))); for (const outputs of Object.values(controls)) for(const {mesh} of outputs) for(const [field,key] of [["positions","positionHash"],["normals","normalHash"]]) assert.equal(createHash("sha256").update(Buffer.from(mesh[field+"Hex"],"hex")).digest("hex"),mesh[key]); console.log("All 12 original typed-array hashes retained across reference process transport");
